resources.name: Open-source DFT software supporting wB97XD/6-31G(d,p) with external electric field capability (e.g., ORCA)

access.notes: ORCA can be installed via conda-forge. It supports the wB97XD functional and the 'field' keyword for external electric fields. The agent may choose any open-source DFT code that supports wB97XD, 6-31G(d,p), counterpoise BSSE correction, and ZPE calculation.

resources.name: Molecular structures of coronene (C24H12) and the nucleobases adenine, thymine, guanine, cytosine

access.notes: Standard geometries can be obtained from PubChem or built using standard chemical knowledge. The agent should construct the initial structures for coronene and the nucleobases. No pre-optimized coordinates are provided.
